metadata.case_name: CHIU AH TUNG v. TANG CHUNG CHUEN AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: Managing a joint venture business named Shenzhen Natural Cosmetic Beauty Co. Ltd.; Legal Representative of the Shenzhen Co.

injuries.description: posterior dislocation of the left hip associated with fracture of the posterior lip of the acetabulum and the antero-inferior part of the femoral head.
source: The plaintiff suffered from a posterior dislocation of the left hip associated with fracture of the posterior lip of the acetabulum and the antero-inferior part of the femoral head.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple injuries of hip or thigh

injuries.description: undisplaced crack fracture at the neck of the right humerus.
source: There was also an undisplaced crack fracture at the neck of the right humerus.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of surgical neck of humerus

manifestations.description: Physical handicap reducing ability to travel in and out of Hong Kong to the Mainland and to various parts of the Mainland with the same agility as before.
Hospitalised and incapacitated for a long time; unable to travel to the Mainland to oversee the company during convalescence.

treatments_received: Closed reduction of the hip dislocation (26 November 1998)
Insertion of Steinmann pin into the left proximal tibia to facilitate skeletal traction (26 November 1998)
Open reduction and internal fixation of the acetabular hip fracture (1 December 1998)
Excision of the femoral head fragment (1 December 1998)

losses.description: Not able to travel in and out of Hong Kong to the Mainland and to various parts of the Mainland with the same agility as before.
Handicap in the employment market (assessed at $100,000).
